name: Faschingerhof
beschreibung:
Perched on a sunny hillside in the hamlet of Hollbruck near Kartitsch, Faschingerhof welcomes visitors with genuine East Tyrolean warmth. Its cosy holiday apartments feature warm timber furnishings, modern conveniences, and breathtaking views of the Carnic Alps.

Farm life enchants families and children with friendly animals and ample outdoor space. Scenic hiking trails start right at the farm gate in summer, while winter brings cross-country ski tracks and ski touring routes.
kurzbeschreibung: Faschingerhof in Hollbruck near Kartitsch offers an authentic farmstay experience in the scenic Tyrolean Gailtal valley.
